response.overview: Juan Goytisolo, the most recent recipient of the Cervantes Prize at the time, is one of the great figures of Spanish literature. This documentary traces his journey south, first through Spain and then Morocco, exploring the emotional and intellectual experiences that shaped his life and work. Through successive ruptures and reinventions, it reveals how Goytisolo became an essential figure in Spanish and world culture.
response.title: Juan Goytisolo (Medineando)
